blocks.text: US President Donald Trump said Tuesday that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un “would like to” attend this week’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit in China, leaving open the possibility of a meeting between the two leaders. “He would like to, yeah. We’ll see what happens,” Trump said during a meeting with leaders of the Quad security grouping on the sidelines of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit in Manila, when asked whether Kim would attend the Apec summit. The remarks came after Trump raised the possibility of meeting Kim during his visit to Shenzhen, China, for the APEC summit, […]...
